title: Bad Restrictions for a DNF Formula
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates and let $k$ be a natural number. The bad restrictions are the coordinate-state assignments $\rho$ for which the decision-tree depth of the Boolean function represented by $\varphi$, after restriction by $\rho$, is at least $k$.
